decided_by: maintainer instruction 'walk through decision then start working' (2026-10-11); choices below are the orchestrator's recorded product assumptions, reversible per choice

surface.chosen: B — code mode lives inside the existing session model
surface.why: A coding session IS a session (bound to workspace+engine, lease-held, shown in the switcher). Reusing the session sheet, switcher and thread gives discoverability for free and adds no new top-level chrome to maintain.

entry.chosen: B — a 'Coding session' toggle in the existing new-session sheet, with an engine picker (default normal-pi, last choice remembered per user)
entry.rejected: A — a /code slash command in the composer
entry.why: The sheet already exists and is discoverable; a slash command hides the feature behind syntax users must learn.

engine.chosen: normal-pi default, omp selectable; last choice remembered in localStorage per user
engine.why: normal-pi is the only engine with a full adapter+conformance record in this deployment; omp is selectable but fails closed via EngineUnavailableError rather than silently switching.

workspace.chosen: v1 uses the bot's existing workspace automatically; no repo picker
workspace.limitation: Users cannot choose or clone a repo from the UI yet — recorded as an explicit non-goal for this slice.

progress_and_results.chosen: a read-only coding panel in the thread: session status, latest run state, acceptance record (outcome + verification commands via the existing codingAcceptance RPC), and workspace diff once the diff RPC lands
progress_and_results.rejected: building the diff/PR view in the same first commit
progress_and_results.why: smallest verifiable sliver first: create+see a coding session end to end before adding richer views.

next_slices: PTY terminal attach for process computers (kind gate + id resolution)
